attributes.name: site identity treatment
attributes.definition: How the site name/brand is presented in the header area.

values.definition: Site name as a simple single-line text wordmark.
Site name as a compact text logo set over multiple lines in a serif face.
No identifiable site identity treatment or something else.

attributes.name: utility link presentation
attributes.definition: How secondary utility links (RSS, quick links) are presented in terms of icon, label and arrangement.

values.definition: Small icon paired with an explicit text label.
Links arranged in a single horizontal row introduced by a small uppercase label.
Plain text links without icon or label heading.
